name.ja: ルドルフ・ディーゼル

overview.en: Rudolf Diesel was a German engineer who invented the diesel engine, a more efficient alternative to the steam and gasoline engines of his era.

early_life.en: Born in Paris to Bavarian immigrants, he studied engineering at the Royal Bavarian Polytechnic in Munich and became obsessed with creating a more efficient engine.

impact.en: The diesel engine he invented became the dominant power source for heavy transport, shipping, and industry, and his vision of running engines on plant oils anticipated modern biofuels.

event.en: Published the theory of the diesel engine
Built the first successful diesel engine in Augsburg
Mysteriously disappeared from a ship crossing the English Channel

title.en: Theory and Construction of a Rational Heat-Motor

description.en: Technical paper describing the principles of the diesel engine

text.en: The use of plant oils as engine fuels may seem insignificant today, but such oils may become in the course of time as important as petroleum.
